recent: RT Pastry 于 2026 年 10 月 29 日宣布，其全资子公司 RT Pastry House Sdn Bhd 拟以 2200 万令吉现金收购位于 Seri Kembangan 的一幅工业用地及厂房；同时，该公司接受了 RHB Islamic Bank 提供的 2878 万令吉银行融资，用于部分资助上述收购。公司最近一期财报（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度）已发布，但未提供具体数据。

RT Pastry in RM22mil land acquisition
RT Pastry proposes RM22mil acquisition of industrial land in Seri Kembangan

recent_en: On 29 October 2026, RT Pastry announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, RT Pastry House Sdn Bhd, proposed to acquire an industrial land and factory in Seri Kembangan for RM22.00 million cash; concurrently, it accepted RM28.78 million in banking facilities from RHB Islamic Bank to part finance the acquisition. The latest quarterly report for the period ended 30 June 2026 was released, but no specific figures were provided.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of an industrial land and factory in Seri Kembangan for RM22.00 million cash.
Accepted RM28.78 million in banking facilities from RHB Islamic Bank to part finance the acquisition.
